name: Dark Project: TSC Logistics
description: Ransomware attack attributed to Dark Project. | Country: PH | Sector: Transportation | Website: www.tsclogistics.com | About TSC Logistics TSC Logistics specializes in providing advanced transportation solutions that prioritize speed and cost-effectiveness for their clients. A cyberattack has resulted in the exfiltration of nearly 600 gigabytes of highly sensitive data, exposing a vast trove of internal records. The compromised material includes personal employee documents, confidential company financial records, invoices, taxpayer statements, and extensive client information. More than 10,000 PDF files have been leaked, containing unredacted Social Security numbers, driver’s licenses, payroll records, and other protected identifiers, raising the spectre of widespread identity theft and regulatory scrutiny. | Source: https://www.ransomware.live/id/VFNDIExvZ2lzdGljc0BEYXJrIFByb2plY3Q=
